Hi Emma — thanks for the quick note and the screenshot.

Two quick asks while we investigate:
- Can you confirm whether your identity team enforces a strict SameSite or short session TTL on SSO cookies? That can break the redirect handshake.
- Try accepting the invite in a private/incognito window and let me know if you hit the same page.

I’ve looped in Ben from platform ops to pull the invite logs and see whether the SAML RelayState is getting dropped. If we confirm this is an IdP handshake problem, I can reissue the invite using the non-SSO fallback link so you can finish onboarding without your IdP.

We’ll get you live for PO routing.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Manager, Procurement Integrations
Redwood Inference

On Sun, Jun 20, 2027 at 9:34 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’ve looped in Ben from platform ops to pull the invite logs and see whether the SAML RelayState is getting dropped.

Thanks — I pulled the invite transaction for FrescoFoods (invite id: INV-20270620-9083). RelayState is present on our side but the IdP returned a 400 when posting back with the assertion; server logs show an empty session cookie for the callback request. That aligns with Strict SameSite or an aggressive cookie TTL at the IdP.

Immediate remediation options:
1) Re-send a non-SSO one-time invite (no RelayState) so they can complete onboarding with a temporary password. I can generate and send this now.
2) Ask Fresco’s IdP admin to whitelist redwood.com for cross-site cookie flow or relax SameSite for the handoff.

I’m attaching the reinvite log and will reissue a one-time link by default unless you prefer a different route.

Action: Kimberly, confirm and I’ll send the non-SSO invite to the procur e@frescofoods.com inbox.

Attachment: reinvite-log-20270620.txt

We tried the incognito window and saw the same behavior. I reached out to our IdP team — they confirmed they have a SameSite=strict policy and will not change it at the moment. Please go ahead with the non-SSO invite.

I’ve attached our completed W-9 as part of the onboarding docs — let me know if you need anything else to complete vendor setup.

Thanks,
